issue_context.body: ### Which jobs are flaking? - pr:pull-kubernetes-integration - ci-kubernetes-integration-master ### Which tests are flaking? - k8s.io/kubernetes/test/integration/daemonset TestDSCUpdatesPodLabelAfterDedupCurHistories ### Since when has it been flaking? https://storage.googleapis.com/k8s-triage/index.html?pr=1&text=TestDSCUpdatesPodLabelAfterDedupCurHistories Maybe since 9.30? ### Testgrid link https://prow.k8s.io/view/gs/kubernetes-jenkins/logs/ci-kubernetes-integration-master/1580295864935518208 ### Reason for failure (if possible) I didn't find err msg in test files. Instead I found: ``` I1012 19:09:56.872061 102520 event.go:294] "Event occurred" object="one-node-daemonset-test/foo" fieldPath="" kind="DaemonSet" apiVersion="apps/v1" type="Warning" reason="FailedCreate" message="Error creating: Post \"https://127.0.0.1:40641/api/v1/namespaces/one-node-daemonset-test/pods\": context canceled" E1012 19:09:56.872142 102520 daemon_controller.go:1020] Post "https://127.0.0.1:40641/api/v1/namespaces/one-node-daemonset-test/pods": context canceled E1012 19:09:56.871741 102520 scheduling_queue.go:982] "Error while retrieving next pod from scheduling queue" err="scheduling queue is closed" ``` 12 other tests failed because of `context canceled` these days. https://storage.googleapis.com/k8s-triage/index.html?pr=1&text=context%20canceled Maybe it's because of bad network?
